text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, with >100,000 CFU/mL Enterococcus faecalis in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Presence of blood and mild proteinuria are likely secondary to infection. No casts detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
